analysis_rules.fixed_impossibility: phase-independent lower bound from exactly-two-distinct-bit arrivals on full within-hour inter-check intervals plus a mean-only lower bound for long periods
analysis_rules.causal_witness: one-hour delayed external rate; continuous cyclic scan rate r(t)=nu_hat(t)/C; C chosen from a 0.95 epsilon risk allocation using lag1 eta and a conservative endpoint-sum bound
analysis_rules.conditional_write_resource: for hard resource admission count every read plus an optional write slot as if every word were corrected; skipped clean-word write slots are therefore only upside
analysis_rules.application_delay: research network-calculus bound (burst_service + one scrub word grab)/(1-rho_app-rho_scrub_peak), valid only when denominator positive
analysis_rules.level2_gate: run Level II only if at least one primary documented memory configuration has causal_full_contract=true and fixed_proven_impossible=true at the same epsilon/budget/load
